name: Rinka
source:
An "empty" young girl who carries nothing.

She has nothing she wants to do and just lives by going along with the flow of what is around her. Despite being conscious of her "emptiness" she does nothing.

Depending on the side you choose, the heroine has a disciplinary committee uniform and a delinquent uniform.

[From [url=http://otome-jikan.net/2015/05/10/bad-apple-wars/]Otome Jikan[/url]]
